text:
Politics at Sam and Anne’s Two of Westminster’s best-connected journalists Anne McElvoy and Sam Coates bring you everything you need to know about British politics.
Apple Music Amazon Music Sky News At its core, will this be a John Healey or an Andy Burnham budget – and will it deliver any real breathing space?
With the biggest fiscal event of the year looming, Sam Coates and Anne McElvoy examine some of the cabinet divisions across a range of topics, including oil drilling, migration policy and a new relationship with Europe.
Plus, is the prime minister reopening Labour’s battle over Europe and free movement? Where are the red lines for the party, Andy Burnham and the country?
